questions.stemHtml: A 25-year-old male presents with progressive night blindness and peripheral vision loss since adolescence. Fundoscopic examination findings is shown in the image. Which of the following electrophysiologic findings is most consistent with the pathology shown?

options.label: A
options.text: Normal photopic and scotopic responses on electroretinography (ERG)

options.label: B
options.text: Absent cone responses, preserved rod responses

options.label: C
options.text: Extinguished or severely reduced scotopic and photopic ERG responses

options.label: D
options.text: Increased b-wave amplitude with preserved a-wave on ERG
